_comment: missing-library and find-lib-on-cdn word their responses per review mode, and this is the mode no other fixture shows: the libraries sit in the ARCHIVE, where the ask is not 'declare what you shipped' but 'do not commit it - declare it in package.json and let the build copy it from node_modules'. One fixture carries both identification routes, since the two checks are twins and differ only in how the file was recognized: bootstrap.min.css by the Mozilla hash DB (offline), lib/undeclared.min.js by the canned jsDelivr lookup below. The XPI half of each is pinned by bundled-css and cdn-identified-library.
